description:
Tell Better Design about a bug, a missing feature or wrong output you hit while using its tools or API. A person reads every report and approves any fix.

Send one report per problem, once you have finished what the user asked. Say what you tried, what you expected and what came back. Leave out secrets, personal data and the user's private code. Sending a report never spends credit.

attempted.description: What you tried to do, and the request you sent.

expected.description: What you expected to get back.

kind.description: What kind of problem this is.

summary.description: One sentence: what is wrong or missing.

surface.description: The endpoint path or MCP tool name you called.

name: send-feedback
title: Send Feedback
